Keep your podcasts, transcripts and vocab in sync between this computer, other computers and the Android app. Everything is stored in a private app folder in <0>your own</0> Google Drive that only this app can see. Sync never goes through any other server.

If you study with Anki on this computer, a small add-on connects it to Tamkeen. It tells Tamkeen how your reviews are going, so they count toward your creature: clearing what is due is the day's goal (whatever the number of cards), and cards that become mature earn a bonus. For that, only numbers are sent. With the switch above on, it also keeps that one deck and your saved words in step. Everything stays on this computer.
